rationale: C04 plausibly supplied a material organizational template: establish a new coordinating entity, place a presidentially appointed and compensated official at its head, authorize personnel and experts within available funds, require departments and agencies to provide information and assistance, and direct maximum use of existing agency facilities. The child adapts this machinery to a board-plus-director structure for psychological operations. C14 and C12 contain related board/director and interagency-coordination machinery, but neither matches the child's combined staffing, assistance, and resource-utilization provisions as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is established under the Board a Director who shall be designated by the President and who shall receive compensation of $16,000 per year.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: At the head of the Administration shall be an Administrator who shall be appointed by the President with compensation at the rate of $17,500 a year, and who may appoint a Deputy Administrator with compensation at the rate of $16,000 a year.
shared_material.explanation: Both create a new entity with a presidentially selected, specifically compensated executive official.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Director, within the limits of funds and personnel made available by the Board for this purpose, shall organize and direct a staff... which may include individuals employed for this purpose, including part-time experts
shared_material.parent_excerpt: To the extent necessary to carry out the provisions of this order, the Administrator is authorized... to employ civilian personnel... The Administrator is authorized to employ experts and consultants
shared_material.explanation: The child uses substantially the same staffing machinery, including ordinary personnel and experts subject to resource limits.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The participating departments and agencies shall afford to the Director and the staff such assistance and access to information as may be specifically requested
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Administrator and... to furnish the Administrator such information and Assistance as he may require
shared_material.explanation: This is a close adaptation of the interagency cooperation and information-access clause.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the board shall utilize to the maximum extent the facilities and resources of the participating departments and agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Administrator shall, to the extent practicable, utilize existing facilities and services of the departments and other agencies.
shared_material.explanation: Both direct the new coordinating body to rely on existing departmental facilities and resources rather than duplicate them.
